result_text:
I fixed both defects. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or add a new one.

1. **Group graph crash:** in `ComponentGroupsUtils.getGroupDependencies`, the reverse-direction branch looked up `key1`, which isn't in the map there, hence the NPE. It now adds the new count to the existing `key2` link. A 3-file dependency from "Group 1" to "Group 2" plus a 2-file one back gives a single link labelled 5.
2. **Zero-LOC percentage:** in `ComponentDependenciesDetailsRenderer.getFromDependencyCoverageSvg`, the percentage is now 0 when the referring component has no counted lines. The text then reads "0%". `SimpleOneBarChart.getPercentageSvg` already enforces a minimum bar width of 1, so the bar stays minimal.

Both files are under `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/generators/statichtml/`.
